column1: # Shared byte-size formatter vectors — asserted by BOTH implementations.
# A table's size cell is formatted twice in this project, once per language and
# with no way to share the code: the desktop app's `model::byte_cell` (Rust) and
# the browser demo's `sizeCell` (TypeScript, in the wasm crate's web/ package).
# Each side asserts every row below, so a change to either formatter that is not
# mirrored in the other fails a test instead of drifting unnoticed.
#   gui-exact   desktop app, human-readable sizes OFF (its default)
#   gui-human   desktop app, human-readable sizes ON
#   demo-exact  browser demo, human-readable sizes OFF
#   demo-human  browser demo, human-readable sizes ON (its default)
# The two agree from 1 KB through the demo's largest unit. They differ by design
# in three places, each pinned by a row here: below 1024 bytes (the app always
# prints two decimals and groups thousands, the demo prints whole bytes), at zero
# (the demo prints an em dash, having nothing to show), and past TB (the demo
# defines no larger unit and keeps counting in TB).
